title: How to make drawstrings pass over the waistband ?
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/10408eead82846569912ed3af53b9ed9/images/87f53d14feda496ab201e2099e156324737350602_0340_0340.jpg)

Hello,

I am currently working on a pair of shorts with drawstrings. Using the **Layer** function, I successfully attached the drawstrings to the inside of the waistband. However, I want the drawstrings to pass over the top edge of the waistband (visible on the outside) instead of being hidden inside.

The process to achieve this seems very laborious. Is there a more efficient way to make the drawstrings appear sewn or attached at the back but exit and drape naturally over the waistband?

Thank you for your advice!

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: You can try using the sewing tool to direct the drawstrings and apply a specific angle to force them down once they are over the waistband. You can find this option in the seam properties.
content_description: This webpage aims to provide tips and techniques for efficiently designing and attaching visible drawstrings on shorts while maintaining a polished look.

title: About fur map
content:
I’ve been wondering if there are any specific tutorials or explanations about the ‘Fur Map,’ especially regarding the Bend ,the Bend Direction and Initial Direction maps.

According to the manual in the CLO Help Center, it mentions that the Fur Map is influenced by a grayscale map. However, after the recent update, I noticed that Bend Direction and Initial Direction in the maps are affected by a Normal Map.

From what I’ve tested, Length, Density, Thickness, Curl, Bend and Gravity are affected by the grayscale map, but the others are not.

What I’m curious about is the role and differences between the following:

• Bend Map

• Direction Bend Map

• Initial Bend Map

what map type should i use for each of those(Normal or grayscale)? 

and **What is the role of each map?**

I attached what I've test. which is about Bend and initial direction map.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/63e5722d43d14789a31ee9856084451e/images/fcc5da98bb2340edbd9816b5c02d75a0%E1%84%89%E1%85%B3%E1%84%8F%E1%85%B3%E1%84%85%E1%85%B5%E1%86%AB%E1%84%89%E1%85%A3%E1%86%BA%202025-01-22%20%E1%84%8B%E1%85%A9%E1%84%92%E1%85%AE%204.45.41.png)

“As I studied, I noticed both similarities and differences.

The similarity is that all of them cause clumping of the fur.

The difference lies in the degree of clumping and the clarity of the fur’s texture lines, which vary.

Based on my tests, it seems that Bend Direction and Initial Direction are used to represent clumping, but I’m really curious about how exactly they differ as well as the Bend.

**I’d appreciate any help. Please let me know! :)**

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi, there are several articles regarding fur among the help manual. But have you also seen this one? https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001526568-Express-Fur If you scroll further down, the updates in 2024.2 to the map options are explained in detail.
content_description: This webpage aims to clarify the roles and differences between the Bend Map, Direction Bend Map, and Initial Bend Map in relation to their influence on fur clumping and texture in CLO, while addressing the impact of both grayscale and normal maps.

title: Print layout issue
content:
While "print layout" clicked it doesn't open the print layout editor

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/3733244634fd4e50870453895a2671ce/images/e6baa4dad9fd4937895216df766cfdb6print%20layout%20issue.PNG)

title: 用户自定义中心的字体大小设置失效
content:
关于用户自定义中心的字体大小设置失效的问题又来依旧。

去年我已经针对此问题反应到CLO，但是不了了之。以前的有关问题是把用户定义界面的字体大小设置项直接取消了。这可是丢失看基本的商业信誉的做法。因为我是一个付费5年的用户，是花钱买服务，你随意裁撤我买到的服务，是很失商业信誉的行为。

如今补充了这个字体大小设置功能，但是这个功能是无效的，也是一个摆设。

请拿出你们的诚意做好这个基本的功能

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/71bd487e2aeb4ac894751b7073dce29e/images/9302742a74b548f48e93da9ad0b1d7a3%E5%BE%AE%E4%BF%A1%E5%9B%BE%E7%89%87_20250121172608.png)

The font can be increased up to size 20. This will increase the size of the Text in the 2D window for things in the Information 2D Vertical Toggle like lines Line Length and AnglesIf you need further technical assistance please reach out directly through our Contact Us page on the CLO Website

title: ✨Have you heard of the #MyDigitalCloset challenge?
content:
We’re currently running a really cool challenge, and the experience has been so fun and special!

The theme of the challenge,**#MyDigitalCloset** , invites participants to combine their items with CONNECT’s motion to tell unique stories in their own digital spaces.

So far, this challenge has had two rounds, and the submissions we’ve received have been truly moving. From stunning outfits to creative concepts, the entries are brimming with passion, energy, and originality.

* * *

We’re excited to share the highlight videos from Round 1 and Round 2 with you.

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NibhrPO2PnY

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e5cmrTtVkH8

These videos are being shared through our Instagram([@closet_connect_official](https://www.instagram.com/closet_connect_official/)) and community channels, and they’ve also received great feedback and brought a lot of joy within CLO.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/5266c10158e14383825d34f1c4e49346/images/34c12928acfb45af8fb7ca31e7b2ba41challenge.png)

Even if your work didn’t make it into the highlight video, your participation was an important part of what made this challenge so special.

* * *

# **_Did you miss out on the first two rounds? Don’t worry!_**

**The 3rd challenge is coming soon, and it’s going to be even more exciting and thrilling—so stay tuned!**

We sincerely thank everyone who took part in **#MyDigitalCloset** challenge, and every moment we shared through it was truly precious. Don’t worry if you missed out this time; there will be plenty more opportunities coming your way. We look forward to seeing even more creative challenges ahead!

Plus, if you have any challenge ideas you’d love to see, feel free to share them in the comments!

**_Let’s enjoy this challenge together!🎉🎀_**

  


![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/5266c10158e14383825d34f1c4e49346/images/f647f4f6604d47478168a602756ef5db%EC%8B%9C%ED%80%80%EC%8A%A4%2002_reel.00_00_02_20.%EC%8A%A4%ED%8B%B8%20001.png)

title: CLO Indonesia Enterprise Forum: Create and Collaborate 🇮🇩
content:
YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JfCloldHmAQ

We hosted an Indonesia Enterprise Forum 🇮🇩 that brought together industry leaders and CLO software users to "Create and Collaborate". The event centered around fostering collaboration among stakeholders within the supply chain.  
  
A big thank you to our guest speakers from SEJUNG GROUP and TP for sharing their brand and manufacturing perspectives using CLO software. Industry experts from Busana Apparel Group and Daehan Global engaged in a thought-provoking discussion on "Bridging the Gap with 3D Apparel Solution" showcasing the power of collaborative solutions in the industry.

Let's continue the collaboration. 🤝

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/6617908fe9324d0a8cb8d075548bc3d2/images/8c35aec85ba143dfb1785f5419181ab4Screenshot%202025-01-17%20at%2011.03.28%E2%80%AFAM.png)
content_description: Explore highlights from the Indonesia Enterprise Forum, where industry leaders united to discuss innovative collaboration in the supply chain using CLO software.
